Exhibition name: Lavender Midinette
rows.Origin: Bred by Ralph S. Moore (United States).
rows.Bloom: Purple to lavender, yellow stamens. Moderate fragrance. Cluster-flowered, in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower, garden or pillar. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
